description: This file defines the EmployeeDeletedEvent class within the OrangeHRM system. It represents an event triggered when an employee is deleted, encapsulating employee number(s) as data.

classes.name: EmployeeDeletedEvent
classes.description: An event class that indicates an employee has been deleted, carrying employee number(s) as its data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a list of employee numbers.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers associated with the deletion event.
